QuestInfo.name: [Glory] Basic Mission: The Spisan's Request
QuestInfo.0:
#bBasic Mission: The Spisan's Request#k

#eMission Period#n
01/01/2020 12:00 AM - 01/14/2020 11:59 PM UTC

#eEvent Details#n
A disciple of the Spisa order has come seeking to harness Maple World's technology for the good of their people.

Checky agreed to assist the Spisan in a joint research project. Together they invented the exploding robot #bKaboom Bomber#k. Help the Spisan test the #bKaboom Bomber's#k performance, and deliver combat data to Checky so they can perform upgrades.


#bYou cannot participate in this mission if you've already reached the daily Glory limit.#k
